title: Neighbourhood market report
description: What one district's neighbourhoods looked like on one day. Listing prices are not transaction prices: the series measures direction, never an absolute value, and only exists from the day collection started. A report is a dated observation and is never edited — a correction is a new file naming the one it replaces.

captured_at.description: To the second, when two readings of one district happen on one day.

supersedes.description: The file this reading replaces, when it is a correction. The older file stays on disk.

sale_per_m2.description: TRY per square metre asked, not paid. Absent when nothing usable was found — which is a finding, not a failure.

listing_count.description: How many listings the figures rest on. A median over three of them is noise wearing a number's clothes, so the count travels with the figure.

basis.description: Where the figure comes from. Official sales counts and listing medians are different kinds of evidence and must not be read as one.

source.description: Where this came from, in words. A figure nobody can go and check is not evidence, and it is worse than a gap because it looks like evidence.
